assignment.bulkHint: 所选任务使用同一主责和协办。留空协办会移除已有协办；截止日期留空则保留原日期。逐项保存，失败项会单独列出。

The selected tasks use the same primary assignee and assistant. An empty assistant removes existing assistants; an empty due date keeps each original date. Tasks save individually; failures are listed separately.
